## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and all relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and example configuration are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, customer data, or production artifacts are included.
- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line and complies with `DCO.md`.
- [ ] I have identified third-party code/assets and preserved their license notices.
